svg.title: Side-loaded straight-belt pickup timing
svg.desc: Top-down layout diagrams appear above the matching timelines. Both incoming lanes feed ONE receiving lane · shown patterns depend on supply and starting phase Each green dot is a four-item stack pickup; the hand contains sixteen items after the fourth dot. All rows share a tick axis starting at the first grab. Total ticks include the first and last grab.
